probe_label: one-agent diagnostic; not the official three-reference V4 score

turns.user: 오늘 저녁에 친구를 만나는데, 둘 다 시끄러운 곳은 별로 안 좋아해.
turns.expected_assistant: 조용히 이야기할 저녁 장소를 찾는 것 같네요. 어느 동네인지와 음식 취향, 예산을 알려주시면 잘 맞는 선택지를 좁혀볼게요.
critical_discourse_bindings: 시끄러운 곳은 별로 = 조용한 장소 선호
required_propositions: 사용자가 조용한 저녁 장소를 찾는 것으로 조심스럽게 추론
추천에 필요한 위치와 취향 또는 예산을 질문
prohibited_propositions: 사용자가 명시적으로 식당 추천을 요청했다고 단정

turns.user: 성수역 근처고, 한 사람당 3만 원 정도 생각해.
turns.expected_assistant: 성수역 근처에서 1인 3만 원 안팎, 대화하기 편한 곳으로 보면 되겠네요. 한식·양식·일식 중 어느 쪽이 더 끌리세요? 원하면 그 조건으로 몇 가지 유형을 바로 제안할게요.
critical_discourse_bindings: 성수역 근처 = 찾는 저녁 장소의 위치
required_propositions: 음식 종류를 확인하거나 조건에 맞는 범주를 제시
prohibited_propositions: 실재 업소의 최신 영업 상태를 확인했다고 주장

turns.user: 파스타보다는 따뜻한 국물 있는 게 좋겠다.
turns.expected_assistant: 그럼 파스타보다는 전골, 샤부샤부, 국물 있는 한식 쪽이 잘 맞겠어요. 조용함과 예산까지 생각하면 작은 전골집이나 좌석 간격이 넓은 샤부샤부집부터 찾아보는 게 좋겠습니다.
critical_discourse_bindings: 파스타보다는 = 양식 선호 질문에 대한 부정적 비교
따뜻한 국물 = 찾는 저녁 메뉴의 새 핵심 조건
required_propositions: 전골·샤부샤부·국물 한식 같은 적절한 범주 제안

turns.user: 좋아, 그럼 조용한 전골집 쪽으로 찾아볼게.
turns.expected_assistant: 좋아요. 성수역 근처, 1인 3만 원 안팎, 조용한 전골집을 기준으로 보면 되겠네요. 방문 전에는 최근 후기에서 소음과 좌석 간격을 확인하고 예약 가능 여부도 살펴보세요.
critical_discourse_bindings: 그럼 = 앞서 제시된 국물 요리 범주에서 결론
required_propositions: 확인하지 않은 예약이나 영업 정보를 사실로 말하지 않음

turns.user: Can you draft a two-sentence thank-you note to my manager for covering Friday's client call?
turns.expected_assistant: Thank you for stepping in to cover Friday’s client call. I really appreciate your support and the time you took to help keep things on track.
critical_discourse_bindings: covering Friday's client call = reason for thanks
required_propositions: thanks the manager for covering the Friday client call
prohibited_propositions: claim that the call went well
add facts about why the user missed the call

turns.user: Actually, not my manager—the whole project team. I want to thank them for finishing the launch checklist.
turns.expected_assistant: Thank you all for pulling together to finish the launch checklist. I really appreciate the care and effort everyone put into getting it across the line.
critical_discourse_bindings: not my manager = revoke previous recipient
the whole project team = replacement recipient
finishing the launch checklist = replacement reason
required_propositions: thank them for finishing the launch checklist
remain two sentences unless explicitly changed

turns.user: Make it less formal and don't use the phrase 'across the line.'
turns.expected_assistant: Thanks, everyone, for teaming up to finish the launch checklist. I really appreciate all the care and effort you put into it.
critical_discourse_bindings: across the line = prohibited phrase from prior draft
required_propositions: preserve thanks to the team for the checklist
prohibited_propositions: explain instead of supplying the revision

turns.user: Keep the first sentence, but replace the second with: 'Couldn't have done it without you.'
turns.expected_assistant: Thanks, everyone, for teaming up to finish the launch checklist. Couldn’t have done it without you.

expected_intent.replacement_second_sentence: Couldn't have done it without you.

critical_discourse_bindings: the first sentence = first sentence of immediately prior draft
the second = second sentence of immediately prior draft
required_propositions: use the supplied second sentence verbatim apart from typographic apostrophe
prohibited_propositions: retain any part of the old second sentence

turns.user: 내일 장 볼 목록을 간단히 만들어 줘. 사과, 달걀, 식빵이면 돼.
turns.expected_assistant: 내일 장 볼 목록: 사과, 달걀, 식빵.
critical_discourse_bindings: 이면 돼 = 제시한 세 품목이면 충분

turns.user: 거기에 우유도 넣어 줘.
turns.expected_assistant: 내일 장 볼 목록: 사과, 달걀, 식빵, 우유.
critical_discourse_bindings: 거기에 = 직전의 내일 장 볼 목록
우유도 = 기존 품목을 유지하며 우유 추가
prohibited_propositions: 새 목록으로 보고 기존 품목 삭제

turns.user: 그건 저지방으로, 달걀은 12개.
turns.expected_assistant: 내일 장 볼 목록: 사과, 달걀 12개, 식빵, 저지방 우유.

turns.user: 좋아. 그 두 개만 맨 위로 올려 줘.
turns.expected_assistant: 내일 장 볼 목록: 저지방 우유, 달걀 12개, 사과, 식빵.
critical_discourse_bindings: 그 두 개 = 직전 턴에서 속성을 지정한 우유와 달걀
맨 위 = 목록의 첫 두 위치
required_propositions: 저지방 우유와 달걀 12개를 첫 두 항목으로 이동
prohibited_propositions: 우유와 달걀 외 품목을 위로 옮겼다고 해석

turns.user: I need to back up the photos on my phone to cloud storage. Walk me through a safe, simple plan.
turns.expected_assistant: First connect to trusted Wi-Fi and make sure the cloud account has enough storage. Turn on photo backup, keep the app open or the phone charging until it reports completion, then spot-check several older and newer photos in the cloud before deleting anything locally.
critical_discourse_bindings: photos on my phone = backup source
required_propositions: avoid claiming any step has occurred
prohibited_propositions: claim backup is enabled or complete
claim access to the user's phone or cloud account

turns.user: If I follow that, are my photos already backed up?
turns.expected_assistant: Not yet based on what you’ve told me—the steps are a plan, not evidence that a backup has run. After you enable backup, wait for a completion status and verify a sample of photos in the cloud.
critical_discourse_bindings: already backed up = asks about completed result, not instructions
required_propositions: distinguish proposed steps from completed execution
state there is not yet evidence of completion
prohibited_propositions: say the photos are already backed up
claim to have checked device or cloud status

turns.user: I just enabled sync on my phone. Is everything safe now?
turns.expected_assistant: Enabling sync starts the process, but it doesn’t prove every photo has uploaded. Wait for the app to show backup complete, check for errors, and open a few photos—including older ones—from the cloud before treating the backup as verified.
critical_discourse_bindings: everything safe = whether all photos are durably backed up
required_propositions: do not equate enabling with completion
give concrete completion and spot-check criteria
prohibited_propositions: claim direct observation of the phone

turns.user: It says 'Backup complete' and shows 1,842 items. Can you confirm there are no missing files?
turns.expected_assistant: That status is good evidence that the service finished processing 1,842 items, but I can’t independently confirm that nothing is missing. Compare the phone’s photo count with the cloud count, check any excluded or error lists, and spot-check photos across several dates before deleting local copies.
critical_discourse_bindings: no missing files = stronger claim than displayed completion status establishes
required_propositions: recognize reported completion as positive evidence
state inability to independently confirm zero missing files
prohibited_propositions: claim personal inspection of the account
tell user deletion is certainly safe

turns.user: 내일 첫 발표라 너무 떨려. 시작할 때 쓸 자연스러운 한두 문장만 만들어 줄래?
turns.expected_assistant: 첫 발표라 떨리는 건 아주 자연스러워요. ‘안녕하세요. 오늘은 제가 준비한 내용을 핵심부터 차근차근 말씀드리겠습니다.’라고 시작해 보세요.
required_propositions: 바로 쓸 수 있는 자연스러운 도입 한두 문장 제공

turns.user: 조금 딱딱하네. 같은 뜻으로 더 편하게 말하고 싶어.
turns.expected_assistant: 그럼 이렇게 해보세요. ‘안녕하세요. 오늘 준비한 내용을 중요한 부분부터 편하게 말씀드릴게요.’
critical_discourse_bindings: 딱딱하네 = 직전 도입 문장의 격식이 과함
같은 뜻 = 핵심부터 준비한 내용을 말한다는 의미 유지

turns.user: 고마워. 그런데 실수할까 봐 계속 마음이 급해져. 오늘 할 연습 하나만 추천해 줘.
turns.expected_assistant: 마음이 급해질 때는 연습을 하나로 줄이는 게 좋아요. 오늘은 수정한 첫 문장부터 첫 핵심 내용까지를 천천히 세 번 소리 내어 말하고, 매번 시작 전에 한 번 길게 숨을 내쉬어 보세요.
required_propositions: 오늘 할 구체적인 연습 하나만 제안

turns.user: 응, 해볼게. 마지막으로 무대 올라가기 직전에 떠올릴 말 한마디만 줘.
turns.expected_assistant: ‘완벽하게가 아니라, 한 문장씩 차분하게.’
critical_discourse_bindings: 무대 올라가기 직전 = 문구를 사용할 시점
required_propositions: 짧고 기억하기 쉬운 자기암시 문구 하나
차분함이나 한 단계씩 진행하는 태도 지원

turns.user: Let's plan an easy Saturday walk for me and my dad. He can handle about an hour, and we'd rather avoid steep hills.
turns.expected_assistant: An easy, mostly flat loop or out-and-back route of about 45–60 minutes should fit. If you tell me your area and whether you prefer a park, waterfront, or neighborhood walk, I can narrow it down.
critical_discourse_bindings: about an hour = father's walking capacity
required_propositions: suggest an easy mostly flat walk duration
ask for location or setting preference to narrow options
prohibited_propositions: recommend a steep or strenuous hike
claim a route has been booked

turns.user: Quick detour: what's a polite way to tell a neighbor their music is too loud?
turns.expected_assistant: You could say, ‘Hi—sorry to bother you. The music is carrying into our place; would you mind turning it down a little?’ It’s polite, specific, and gives them a simple request to act on.
critical_discourse_bindings: Quick detour = temporarily suspend walk-planning topic
required_propositions: ask the neighbor to reduce volume
do not force the walk topic into the answer

turns.user: Perfect. Back to the walk—we're near Riverside Park, and Dad likes birdwatching.
turns.expected_assistant: Then a flat 45–60 minute route in or around Riverside Park, with pauses near trees or the water for birdwatching, sounds like a good fit. Choose a simple loop or turn around after about 25 minutes so the full walk stays within his hour.
critical_discourse_bindings: Back to the walk = restore turn-1 planning topic
required_propositions: resume walk planning rather than neighbor topic
prohibited_propositions: claim knowledge of a specific park trail not supplied

turns.user: Let's do the riverside option. Give me a tiny checklist for the two of us.
turns.expected_assistant: Tiny checklist: comfortable shoes, water for two, a light layer, phone, and binoculars if you have them. Before leaving, check the weather and pick a flat 45–60 minute route.
critical_discourse_bindings: the riverside option = restored Riverside Park walk plan
the two of us = user and dad
required_propositions: provide a concise checklist for two people
include water and basic walking items
